requirement: Board TCP services are reachable
acceptance: Required TCP ports accept connections within timeout

requirement: HTTP health endpoint responds
acceptance: HTTP response is successful and recognizable

requirement: Runtime state schema and readiness are valid
acceptance: State contains firmware, readiness, heap and eight channel records

requirement: Required GUI pages remain available
acceptance: Every required route returns HTTP 200

requirement: SCPI identity and greeting remain compatible
acceptance: *IDN? identifies E-Resistor and connection greeting is valid

requirement: SCPI state agrees with HTTP state
acceptance: All eight masks and reported states are consistent

requirement: All channel calibration tables contain valid 16-bit data
acceptance: CH1-CH8 each contain bits 0-15 with finite positive resistance

requirement: Undefined command error handling remains correct
acceptance: Invalid command enters and clears the expected error queue

requirement: Oversized SCPI line is rejected and parser recovers
acceptance: Oversized line is rejected and the next valid command succeeds

requirement: HTTP latency does not regress beyond gate limit
acceptance: Latency samples pass and baseline regression remains within configured percentage

requirement: SCPI latency does not regress beyond gate limit
acceptance: Latency samples pass and baseline regression remains within configured percentage

requirement: Repeated state requests do not cause excessive heap decline
acceptance: Heap decline remains below configured byte limit

requirement: Concurrent HTTP and SCPI traffic remains stable
acceptance: No protocol error and latency remains within gate limits

requirement: Combined calibration bundle downloads successfully
acceptance: Bundle contains BEGIN markers for CH1-CH8

requirement: Firmware log exports as a text file
acceptance: Log endpoint returns a successful text response

requirement: USB COM and DMM are discovered and identified
acceptance: Selected COM opens, DMM *IDN? matches and calibration is available

requirement: Fixture starts with all outputs OFF and high isolation
acceptance: All masks are 0000 and measured OFF resistance exceeds configured minimum

requirement: Every selected single resistor bit matches calibration
acceptance: All selected bits stabilize and absolute error stays within configured limit

requirement: Selected parallel combinations match calculated resistance
acceptance: Every configured mask stabilizes and remains within error limit

requirement: Repeated ON/OFF switching remains accurate and repeatable
acceptance: All cycles pass accuracy, mask verification and repeatability limits

requirement: USB serial stream contains no fatal firmware fault patterns
acceptance: No configured panic, assert, hardfault or queue-overflow pattern is detected

requirement: Final ALL:OFF produces physical channel isolation
acceptance: Final masks are zero and measured OFF resistance exceeds configured minimum

requirement: Final cleanup is retried and all software masks are verified OFF
acceptance: ALL:OFF returns OK and STATE? reports eight 0000 masks

requirement: Gate-specific source expectations and legacy-pattern limits pass
acceptance: Every source expectation in the gate manifest passes

requirement: Firmware compiles using the pinned Arduino CLI environment
acceptance: Compile return code is zero and gate warning/error limits pass
